purpose: Improve learning with fresh search-policy selfplay, balanced sampling, cosine fine-tuning and EMA; preserve fixed v3 architecture and optimized inference.

selfplay.temperature: 1 for first min(18,N/3), .25 until N/2, then argmax

training.split: Preserve all baseline train/validation IDs; split only new games.
training.selection: Minimum balanced held-out-game validation loss including epoch-zero baseline

diagnostics.role: development diagnostic; do not call independent after using for selection

final.role: new paired openings, all six boards, unchanged search rules

replacementGuard: At least 30/48 score against the frozen baseline, no board below 25%, no capped games; validate inference and reported endgame. Otherwise retain deployed model. No statistically established strength claim.

amendments.stage: Before full training, after baseline endgame diagnostic
amendments.reason: Baseline knows the reported loss with >99.99% probability but pass prior is about 0.0000025 after the large capture.

curriculum.input: Fresh selfplay games only; never the user record
curriculum.policy: Pass only at newly verified certified-loss roots
curriculum.value: Loss; exact margin and ownership after legal branch completion
curriculum.split: Reuse parent gameId for every cleanup branch, so family cannot cross train/validation

amendments.stage: After candidate A validation and development matches; final seed remains unused
amendments.reason: A improved validation loss and pass recall but loses most development games. Suspect diffuse low-visit policy targets; do not promote A.

candidateB.policyAnchor: frozen baseline prior on all positions

amendments.selection: Choose by validation within B; compare with same development openings, retaining all A results; only the selected acceptable candidate sees final seed 20261250.

amendments.stage: After B development 13/24, before any final-seed games
amendments.reason: Isolate value learning from policy drift; B is only a small development gain.

candidateC.trainable: value head only; trunk and policy remain bit-identical

amendments.selection: Compare validation within C and the same development openings; select B or C by development score, reject A. Run final seed 20261250 once on the selected candidate; retain baseline unless the predeclared replacement guard passes.
